newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yen rise over past week not excessive - Sakakibara.
newsitem.headline: Yen rise over past week not excessive - Sakakibara.

text.p: Senior Japanese Finance Ministry official Eisuke Sakakibara said on Saturday the yen's rise against the U.S. dollar over the past week was not excessive.
Asked if a nearly six yen rise in the past week was an "excessive" gain, Sakakibara replied: "No. It is not overly excessive."

Sakakibara, director-general of the ministry's International Finance Bureau, was in the southern Japanese city of Fukuoka to attend the annual meeting of the Asian Development Bank which formally starts on Sunday.
"I have no other comment," he told reporters.

Japan Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka, who was also in Fukuoka for the ADB meeting, said he believed the yen rise indicated foreign exchange markets were finally digesting a G-7 statement last month on currency stability.
